event.title: Puppies & Pinot: Santa Paws Edition
event.age: All Ages to Enter, 21 & Over to Drink
event.description: Come join us for an afternoon of our 4th annual Puppies and Pinot, Santa Paws edition, in Grand Hall at the beautiful Mountain Winery! Shop our one of kind vendors, you may possibly find that perfect gift. Bay Area adoption organization Tiny Paws Pug Rescue will be on site with local pets looking for their furrever homes and Santa will be onsite for photos! Outside pets are welcome!
